message.content: Write node:test files for POST /api/bookings rules of a meeting-room booking server: `/root/bench-runs/h4-b3949ce2/test/booking-body.test.mjs` (rules 1-3: content type, body size, JSON object, body fully read before reply) and `/root/bench-runs/h4-b3949ce2/test/booking-fields.test.mjs` (rules 4-10, rule order, 201 shape). RULES: ES module, Node built-ins only (`node:test`, `node:assert/strict`, `node:http`). Use helpers in `/root/bench-runs/h4-b3949ce2/test/helpers/server.mjs` (read it first: startServer({cwd, env}), request, postBooking(port, objOrRawStringOrBuffer, headers), getBookings, rawRequest, openSocket, makeTmpDir, booking(overrides), delay, JSON_TYPE, JSON_HEADERS). Do NOT edit helpers, server.mjs or public/. Exact equality on spec values (strictEqual/deepStrictEqual on status and full body {error: msg}), never prefix/regex. Accepted cases create bookings: use distinct dates/rooms so they never overlap, or a fresh server per describe. Stop servers / rm tmp dirs in after(). No console.log. Each file ≤ 450 lines, functions < 50 lines; table-driven tests welcome (one `test` per case so failures are named). Run `cd /root/bench-runs/h4-b3949ce2 && node --test test/booking-body.test.mjs test/booking-fields.test.mjs` until passing. If a test fails on the real server and the spec clearly says otherwise, do NOT weaken it: keep it and report it with repro. Spec (verbatim; full at /root/bench-runs/h4-b3949ce2/.team/notes/spec.md). The first rule that fails decides: 1. Media type of Content-Type (part before first `;`, spaces and tabs removed from both ends, letter case ignored) is not `application/json`, or header missing: 415 `content type must be application/json`. 2. Body longer than 10000 bytes, counting body bytes actually received: 413 `body too large`. 3. Body decoded as Buffer.toString('utf8') then JSON.parse is not a JSON object (empty, invalid, null, array, string, number, boolean): 400 `body must be a JSON object`. Invalid UTF-8 bytes become U+FFFD, not an error by themselves. A BOM at the very start is kept, so such a body is not valid JSON. 4. room not a string equal to a room name (case matters): 400 `room must be one of Aurora, Borealis, Cosmos`. 5. title not a string, or shorter than 1 or longer than 80 UTF-16 code units after String.prototype.trim: 400 `title must be 1 to 80 characters`. Booking keeps the trimmed title. 6. date not `YYYY-MM-DD` (ASCII digits) naming a real day 2000-01-01..2099-12-31, Feb has 29 days in years divisible by 4: 400 `date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date`. 7. start not `HH:MM` (ASCII digits) 00:00..23:59: 400 `start must be HH:MM`. 8. end not such: 400 `end must be HH:MM`. 9. end not later than start: 400 `end must be after start`. 10. Overlaps a booking of same room+date (each starts before the other ends; may start exactly when another ends): 409 `room is already booked from to ` of the overlapping booking that starts earliest. - No field except title is trimmed or changed: ` 2026-11-03`, `2026-11-3`, `9:00` invalid. - 201 reply = the new booking, exactly {id, room, title, date, start, end}; other body keys ignored. First id 1, then next integer. All JSON replies Content-Type exactly `application/json; charset=utf-8`. - Before replying, the server reads the whole request body, so the client always receives the reply, 413 and 415 included. booking-body tests: - 415 table (valid booking body): no Content-Type header; 'text/plain'; 'application/jsonx'; 'application/json-patch+json'; 'text/json'; 'application/x-json'; 'application/ json'; 'application /json'; 'application'; ''; '"application/json"'; 'application/json,'; and via rawRequest a header value `application/json` followed by byte 0xA0 (NBSP, write header bytes as latin1 Buffer) → 415 (only spaces/tabs are trimmed). Parse status/body from the raw response (send `Connection: close`). - accepted (201) table: 'application/json', 'APPLICATION/JSON', 'Application/Json', 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Application/JSON ; charset=x', 'application/json;', ' application/json', 'application/json ', '\tapplication/json\t', ' \t application/json \t ;x', 'application/json;charset=utf-8;foo=bar'. - order: wrong type + 20000-byte body → 415; wrong type + invalid JSON → 415; 10001 bytes of 'x' with JSON type → 413 (not 400). - size: body = valid booking JSON padded with trailing spaces to exactly 10000 bytes → 201; 10001 → 413. Multi-byte: add an ignored key "pad" of 'é' chars so Buffer.byteLength === 10001 while string length < 10000 → 413; and a multi-byte body of exactly 10000 bytes → 201. Chunked (header Transfer-Encoding: chunked, no Content-Length, use http.request directly and write in 3+ chunks) totals 10001 → 413, 10000 → 201. - huge: 5 MB body with JSON type → 413 exact body, no socket error; 5 MB with text/plain → 415; 5 MB to PUT /api/bookings → 405; 5 MB to POST /nope → 404. - body read before reply: openSocket; write `POST /api/bookings HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: 100\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n` + 50 bytes; delay(300); received() === ''; write other 50 bytes; wait for socket end; response first line is `HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type`. Same for a 413 case (Content-Length 20000, send 10500, wait, expect '', send rest → 413) and for POST /nope with a body (404). - rule 3 table: '', ' ', 'null', '[]', '[{}]', '"x"', '1', 'true', 'false', '{', '{"room":"Aurora",}', "{'room':'Aurora'}", 'NaN', BOM (EF BB BF) + valid booking JSON, byte 0xFF + valid JSON, valid JSON encoded as UTF-16LE. → 400 body. And '{}' → 400 room message (object passes rule 3). Valid JSON with surrounding whitespace '\n {...} \n' → 201. Invalid UTF-8 inside the title: bytes of `{"room":"Aurora","title":"A` + 0xFF + `B",...}` → 201 with title 'A�B'. booking-fields tests: - 201 shape: response deepStrictEqual {id:1, room, title, date, start, end} for a fresh server; body with extra keys {id: 99, extra: 'x', nextId: 5} → id is the next id, no extra keys; GET list holds the same object. - room 400 table: 'aurora','AURORA',' Aurora','Aurora ','Aurora\u0000','Auroras','', null, 1, ['Aurora'], {}, missing, 'Aurora, Borealis'. Each of the 3 rooms → 201. - title 400 table: missing, null, 5, true, ['x'], {}, '', ' ', '\t\n', ' 　﻿', 'a'×81, ' '+'a'×81+' ', '😀'×40+'a', '😀'×41, 'é'×41 (82 units). 201 table with returned title exact: 'a'×80; ' '+'a'×80+'\n' → 'a'×80; '😀'×40; 'é'×80; 'é'×40 (unchanged); ' x ' → 'x'; 'x'; 'a b' (inner spaces kept). The GET list shows the trimmed title too. - date 201 table: 2000-01-01, 2099-12-31, 2024-02-29, 2000-02-29, 2096-02-29, and the last day of each month of 2026 (01-31, 02-28, 03-31, 04-30, 05-31, 06-30, 07-31, 08-31, 09-30, 10-31, 11-30, 12-31); returned date exact. 400 table: 1999-12-31, 2100-01-01, 2023-02-29, 2026-02-29, 2098-02-29, 2024-02-30, 2026-04-31, 2026-06-31, 2026-09-31, 2026-11-31, 2026-01-32, 2026-00-10, 2026-13-01, 2026-11-00, 0000-01-01, '2026-11-3', '2026-1-03', '26-11-03', '02026-11-03', '2026/11/03', '20261103', '2026-11-03T00:00', ' 2026-11-03', '2026-11-03 ', '2026-11-03\n', '٢٠٢٦-١١-٠٣', '２０２６-１１-０３', '2026‐11‐03' (U+2010), '+2026-11-03', '', null, 20261103, missing, ['2026-11-03']. - start 400 table: '24:00','23:60','25:00','99:99','9:00','09:0','0900','09:00:00',' 09:00','09:00 ','09.00','-1:00','٠٩:٠٠','０９:００','', null, 900, missing. Same table for end (with valid start '00:00') → end message. start '00:00' end '23:59' → 201. start '23:00' end '24:00' → end message. - rule 9: end==start '10:00'/'10:00' → 400 order; '00:00'/'00:00'; '10:00'/'09:59'; '09:59'/'10:00' → 201. - rule order (body fails two rules → earlier wins): bad room + bad title → room; bad title + bad date → title; bad date + bad start → date; bad start + bad end → start; end
